What's New in TrainWatch v2.3.0

- Smart AVL Seat Alerts: Track confirmed (AVL) seats with custom limits (such as AVL < 10) and receive timely "Book Fast" alerts whenever remaining seats drop further.
- Auto-Expiring Alerts: Seat alerts automatically stop monitoring once your train departs, saving battery and keeping your alert list clutter-free with one-tap removal.
- Accurate Live Fare Comparisons: Direct fares, split fares, and price differences now match live availability pricing consistently across screens.
- Better Pre-Boarding & Station Support: Improved midnight-crossing schedule timing and expanded station directory coverage.
